name_official: Proves Bilgi Teknolojileri（İzmir Bayraklı, TR；proves.com.tr；系统集成商）
summary: 伊兹密尔 Bayraklı 的 IT/安防系统集成商 Proves Bilgi Teknolojileri（2020-02 由 Serdar Karasu 创立；IT 安全、基础设施、网络安全、服务器/备份、系统集成；Hanwha Vision 案例：为代尼兹利 Pamukkale 市政部署 150 台 Q 系列摄像机 + 3 台 NVR）。ISAF 记录：Serdar Karasu（bilgi@proves.com.tr）——要工业级交换机报价单；无后续跟进。创始人直接要报价 → 发工业机价目。市政项目为公共部门 → 按个案守界（民用 CCTV 可做）。

evidence.quote: Serdar KARASU is the Founder at Proves Bilgi Teknolojileri, a leading technology company based in Bayrakli, Izmir, Turkey … information technology solutions including security, infrastructure, and cybersecurity … physical and virtual server installations, network security, backup solutions, and system integration

Denizli Pamukkale Municipality in Turkey required a reliable way to monitor its headquarters and surrounding areas around the clock. In collaboration with system integrator Proves Bilgi Teknolojileri, the municipality deployed 150 Hanwha Vision Q series cameras along with three NVRs.
